publicationDecision.scope: Add one bounded older Novo Nordisk Phase 1 omission and append three sponsor-submitted Phase 3 records to the existing ribupatide and safiglipron programmes. Editorial authorisation is not clinical approval.

configuredSourcePass.boundary: A successful SELECT-only health observation checks configured-source availability and monitoring operation. It does not renew a factual review, approve changed copy or establish industry completeness.

entries.name: NNC0638-0355
entries.stage: Active, not recruiting Phase 1; no posted results
entries.summary: Novo Nordisk's sponsor-submitted NCT06577766 record studies subcutaneous single and multiple ascending doses of NNC0638-0355 in adults with overweight or obesity. It records an actual 3 September 2024 start, active-not-recruiting status and 63 actual participants; completion remains estimated for 11 October 2027.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed registry record does not establish UK marketing authorisation for NNC0638-0355.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by this research record.
entries.supply: Clinical research does not establish lawful UK retail supply, pharmacy stock or sale by Shift Some Timber.
entries.limitations: This is an older coverage omission, not a newly started October study. The Phase 1 record evaluates safety, tolerability and pharmacokinetics, has no posted results and does not establish weight-loss efficacy, long-term safety or clinical benefit. The record does not identify a mechanism, so none is inferred. Estimated completion is not a completed event.

additionalEvidence.title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT06577766: NNC0638-0355
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Complete sponsor-submitted API record read for intervention identity, formulation, Phase 1 design, actual start, active-not-recruiting status, actual enrolment, estimated completion and absence of posted results; not automatically content-monitored.

fields.summaryToAppend: Two separate Chinese sponsor-submitted Phase 3 records add specialist and comparator contexts: NCT07285902 is active, not recruiting after an actual 25 December 2025 start and compares HRS9531 injection with semaglutide in 572 actual participants; NCT07709910 studies ribupatide in people with obesity and knee osteoarthritis but remains not yet recruiting with an estimated July 2026 start and 382 estimated participants.
fields.limitationsToAppend: Neither Chinese record has posted results. Active-not-recruiting status and actual enrolment in the comparator study are not comparative results, while the knee-osteoarthritis start remains an estimate. These studies do not establish an authorised osteoarthritis indication, symptom benefit, superiority, UK access or supply.

additionalEvidence.checkScope: Complete sponsor-submitted API record read for Phase 3 comparator design, actual start, active-not-recruiting status, actual enrolment and absence of posted results; not automatically content-monitored.

additionalEvidence.title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07709910: ribupatide in obesity and knee osteoarthritis
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Complete sponsor-submitted API record read for specialist Phase 3 design, not-yet-recruiting status, estimated dates and enrolment, location and absence of posted results; not automatically content-monitored.

fields.stage: Global Phase II ongoing; separate China Phase III results and recruiting hypertension Phase III
fields.summaryToAppend: A separate Chinese sponsor-submitted Phase 3 record, NCT07528027, studies HRS-7535 for blood-pressure control in people with hypertension and overweight or obesity. It is recruiting after an actual 29 May 2026 start with 648 estimated participants.
fields.limitationsToAppend: The hypertension study has no posted results. Recruitment and an actual start do not establish blood-pressure benefit, a new authorised indication, UK access or supply.

additionalEvidence.checkScope: Complete sponsor-submitted API record read for specialist Phase 3 design, recruiting status, actual start, estimated enrolment and absence of posted results; not automatically content-monitored.

discoveryPass.method: A separate current-date pass checked regulator, NHS, product-information and selected sponsor changes. discoveryPass.included: NNC0638-0355 is a distinct older programme absent from the live catalogue. The three Phase 3 records update existing ribupatide and safiglipron programmes rather than being counted as new medicines.
